title: The Stonebreaker's Course
summary: A course in blows that crack stone and bone alike and the heavy stepping that carries the weight into them.

title: Handbook of Shifting Ground
summary: A handbook on making the earth under an opponent heave and slide while the user stays planted behind a guard.

title: The Earthen Shield Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on raising and bracing shields of packed earth and shedding their weight when the blow is done.

title: A Treatise on Mud and Clay Holds
summary: A treatise on holding a foe in wet earth that sets like clay and releasing it again with a thought.

title: The Boulder-Hurler's Workbook
summary: A workbook on tearing larger stones from the ground and throwing them with arm and qi across long distances.

title: Manual of Deep Ground Sensing
summary: A manual on listening through stone for distant steps and hidden hollows and on holding that sense during a fight.

title: The Plated Skin Course
summary: A course that layers hardened earth over the skin in plates that turn blades and blunt strikes.

title: Compendium of the Stone Spike
summary: A compendium on driving narrow spikes of rock up through the ground to pierce and pin at a single point.
